title: 306 の居残り
summary: 黒板の HELLO, WORLD を読めたなら、次は自分で動かす番だと教授は言う。3F の 306 PC ルームでは、TA が夕方まで自習を見ているらしい。
summary_en: Now that you can read HELLO, WORLD on the blackboards, the professor says it is your turn to make it run. In the 3F PC room, 306, a TA keeps an eye on self-study until evening.
rewardText: 306 の画面に、自分の HELLO, WORLD が出た
rewardText_en: Your own HELLO, WORLD appeared on a screen in 306

steps.text: 3F の 306 PC ルームで、TA に声をかける
steps.text_en: Talk to the TA in 306, the PC room on 3F

steps.text: 306 の PC で、HELLO, WORLD を動かす
steps.text_en: Get HELLO, WORLD running on a PC in 306

steps.text: 動いた画面を TA に見せる
steps.text_en: Show the TA the screen that ran

steps.text: 大教室の教授に、動いたと伝える
steps.text_en: Tell the professor in the big classroom that it ran
